questions.stem: 和身體上的傷相比，學生內心所承受的往往比較難被別人看見，但它一樣真實。
questions.answer: Compared with physical injuries, what students suffer inside is often less visible to others, but it is just as real.
accepted_answers: Compared to physical wounds, what students go through emotionally is often harder for others to see, but it is equally real.
In comparison with injuries to the body, what students endure in their hearts is usually less visible to other people, yet it is just as real.

questions.stem: 然而，現在學生等候由學校提供的諮商服務的時間，是五年前的兩倍長。
questions.answer: However, students now wait twice as long as they did five years ago for the counseling services provided by their schools.
accepted_answers: However, students now have to wait twice as long as they did five years ago for the counseling services offered by their schools.
However, the time students spend waiting for the counseling services provided by schools is now twice as long as it was five years ago.

1.explanation_zh: 「和身體上的傷相比」放句首，寫成 Compared with／to physical injuries（過去分詞，不用 Compare／Comparing）。主詞「學生內心所承受的」是「所…的事」，用 what 子句 what students suffer inside（直述句語序），動詞用單數 is。「比較難被別人看見」用 less visible to others 或 harder for others to see，不要寫 difficult to be seen。「但它一樣真實」是 but it is just as real（省略比較對象）。
1.strategy_zh: 「和 A 相比，B …」先想 Compared with A, B + V …；「…所…的」後面不接名詞時，多半是 what 子句。
hints: 切成四段：和身體上的傷相比／學生內心所承受的／往往比較難被別人看見／但它一樣真實
標的詞彙：physical（身體的）、injury（傷）、suffer（承受）、visible（看得見的）、real（真實的）
句型框架：Compared with N, what + S + V + is often less + adj. …, but it is just as + adj.

2.explanation_zh: 「是五年前的兩倍長」用倍數比較 twice as long as …：可以寫 students now wait twice as long as they did five years ago (for …)，也可以保留「時間」當主詞：the time students spend waiting … is now twice as long as it was five years ago。「由學校提供的諮商服務」是被動意味的修飾語，用過去分詞片語後位修飾：the counseling services provided by their schools。
evidence: 由學校提供的諮商服務
2.strategy_zh: 「是…的 N 倍＋形容詞」直接套 N times as + 形容詞 + as …；「由…提供的＋名詞」先想 N + provided by …。
hints: 切成四段：然而，現在學生等候／由學校提供的諮商服務／（的時間，是）五年前／的兩倍長
標的詞彙：student（學生）、wait（等候）、counsel（諮商；counseling services）、service（服務）、provide（提供）、twice（兩倍）
句型框架：S + wait(s) + twice as long as + S + did + 時間 + for + N + p.p. by …

traps.literal_error: Compared with physical injuries, students' inner bearing is often …
traps.explanation_zh: 「內心所承受的」是「所…的事」，英文用 what 子句 what students suffer inside 當主詞，不要逐字造名詞。

bonus.text: Invisible as students' inner pain may be, it is every bit as real as a physical injury.
bonus.explanation_zh: Adj. + as + S + may be（雖然…）是讓步倒裝，語氣更強；屬加分寫法，基本分仍看 what 子句與 Compared with。

1.restructuring_zh: 「學生內心所承受的」用 what 子句當主詞；「和身體上的傷相比」放句首寫成 Compared with physical injuries，被比較的是後面的主詞；「比較難被別人看見」改成 less visible to others 或主動的 harder for others to see。

2.restructuring_zh: 「學生等候…的時間，是五年前的兩倍長」中文用「時間」當主詞，英文可改成動作 students now wait twice as long as they did five years ago；「由學校提供的諮商服務」用過去分詞片語 provided by their schools 放在名詞後面。

1.translation: Compared with physical injuries, what students endure inside is often harder for others to see, but it is just as real.
1.explanation_zh: 「和……相比」用分詞片語 Compared with 放句首；「學生內心所承受的」沒有明確名詞，用 what 名詞子句當主詞；「比較難被別人看見」用 harder for others to see（tough 句構用主動不定詞，不寫 hard to be seen）；「一樣真實」用 just as real。

2.translation: However, the time students now spend waiting for counseling services provided by schools is twice as long as it was five years ago.
2.explanation_zh: 保留中文以「時間」為主詞的結構：the time students spend waiting for…；「由學校提供的」用過去分詞後位修飾 provided by schools；「是五年前的兩倍長」用倍數比較 twice as long as it was five years ago。

issues_zh: 第 3 部分「五年前」的常見錯誤把 than they did five years ago 列為錯，說明卻寫「（twice as long as；或寫 twice longer than）」，等於承認 twice longer than 可以；但第 3、4 部分的 accepted 都沒有 than … five years ago／twice longer。學生照說明寫 students now wait twice longer than they did five years ago 會兩個部分都被扣分，規準自相矛盾。建議二選一：刪掉說明裡的「或寫 twice longer than」，或把 twice longer 與 than they did five years ago 補進 accepted（並刪掉那條常見錯誤）。

第 3 部分 accepted 的 as it did five years ago 只在主要動詞是一般動詞時才通（例如 the wait lasts twice as long as it did …）；和第 1 部分 accepted 的 the time students spend waiting／the waiting time 搭配時主要動詞是 is，會變成 … is twice as long as it did five years ago，不合文法，逐部分比對會誤給分。建議刪除，或在說明註明只能配一般動詞。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 3 部分「五年前」的常見錯誤把 than they did five years ago 列為錯，說明卻寫「（twice as long as；或寫 twice longer than）」，等於承認 twice longer than

1.translation: Compared with physical wounds, what students suffer inside is often harder for others to see, but it is just as real.
1.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用 Compared with…；「學生內心所承受的」用名詞子句 what students suffer inside，主詞單數所以接 is；「比較難被別人看見」用 harder for others to see（see 是不定詞，不必用被動）；「一樣真實」用 just as real。

2.translation: However, students now wait twice as long for the counseling services provided by schools as they did five years ago.
2.explanation_zh: 「是五年前的兩倍長」用倍數比較 twice as long … as they did five years ago；「由學校提供的」用過去分詞 provided by schools 修飾 services；「現在」搭配現在簡單式 wait，「五年前」用過去式 did。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者說用了句型 COMP，程式在譯文裡看不出來
